units.source_text: 太阳开始西斜，群山锁在彩霞中。

en.t: The sun began to sink westward, and the mountains were locked in the glow of the evening clouds.

units.source_text: 几名游人和我们父子先后钻进了大门。

en.t: Several sightseers and then my father and I slipped through the main gate one after another.

units.source_text: 门的左侧，围绕钟楼种植着挂着残花的梅林。

en.t: On the left side of the gate, a grove of plum trees still bearing a few lingering blossoms had been planted around the bell tower.
